name: Money Stewardship
overview: Scripture teaches that money stewardship involves giving according to the blessings God has provided, as seen in Deuteronomy 16:17, and wisely managing resources rather than spending foolishly, as Proverbs 21:20 warns. Believers are called to faithfully bring tithes to support God's work and trust His promise of abundant blessings in Malachi 3:10. Jesus instructs His followers to prioritize eternal treasures over earthly wealth, emphasizing in Matthew 6:19-20 that heavenly investments are secure from decay and theft. Additionally, the parable in Matthew 25:14 highlights the responsibility entrusted to servants to manage their master's goods faithfully, illustrating the kingdom principle of stewardship.
